title: The exchange map of a full inverse-image open square is an isomorphism
statement: Let f:X\to S and f_U:X_U\to U be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and j_U:U\to S and j_X:X_U\to X open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Assume j_X followed by f equals f_U followed by j_U, and image(j_X)=f^{-1}(image(j_U)). For every module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the mate of f_*(eta_{j_X,F}) followed by the canonical pushforward composition and equality identifications, under the chosen adjunction for tensorPullback(j_U) [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], is an isomorphism j_U^* f_*F \to f_{U*}j_X^*F [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Compare the restriction adjunctions with the chosen tensor-pullback adjunctions by leftAdjointUniq. Form d as the mate, for restriction along jU, of the pushforward of the restriction unit along jX and the canonical pushforward square.

proof.text: For every open W in U, f inverse-image of jU(W) equals jX(fU inverse-image of W). The reverse inclusion uses the full image hypothesis and injectivity of jU; the forward inclusion uses the commuting square. Evaluate d on W with homEquiv_counit and the restriction unit/counit section formulas. Pushforward composition maps are identities and the congruence maps are restrictions. Hence d.app W is F.presheaf.map of a morphism between equal opens. That morphism is an isomorphism in the thin category of opens, so d is an isomorphism by Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app.

proof.text: The equality eU.hom followed by bc = d followed by fU pushforward of eX.hom follows by injectivity of the restriction Hom equivalence. Naturality of the pushforward square and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app give identical adjoints. Both eU and eX are isomorphisms; cancel eU to conclude bc is an isomorphism.
